verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say you can add a backend to your app to securely store and manage data, and create a backend to manage your content, so a first-party data backend exists. The evidence gives no detail on how the database is provisioned, how it is wired into the generated app's code, or whether this all happens inside the builder. missing for 10: explicit database provisioning details, documented automatic wiring into app code, confirmation the flow stays inside the builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a database provisioned and wired into my app without leaving the builder

citations.quote: You can also [add a backend](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/32640822050199) to your app to securely store and manage data.
Generate and design your frontend in Figma Make, then create a backend to manage your content.
